title: VendPoint Substitute Settling Par — Computation Sheet
content:
Computation of the settling par recorded on the selection of a Corbett-placed substitute on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine.

**Items.** The newest item is the item whose add entry on the machine's selection history carries the highest planogram request reference (Corbett issues these references in sequence); the retired item it replaces is the item of the customer's contract price line written as a removal carrying the highest change reference.

**Counting months.** Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

**A. The selection's units and average.** The selection's units are the units of the substitute and of the retired item vended from the machine in the three months ending today, less the units of either returned to the machine or credited for a vend error in the same three months, each record counted by its date, and its average per restock interval is those units divided by the weeks in that window and by the model's scheduled restock visits per week. The weeks in that window are 13.

**B. The standard par.** The standard par is the selection's average per restock interval divided by the model's low-stock trigger percentage taken as a fraction of one hundred, rounded up to a whole unit.

**C. The settling par.** To fix the settling par, each method that applies first replaces the quantity of the standard par it names; the standard par before its rounding is then multiplied by one plus the allowance that applies and by each share and factor that applies, and the result is rounded up to a whole unit only at the end.

### Hypothetical worked figures

| Selection's units, three months | Visits per week | Low-stock trigger | Average per restock interval | Before rounding | Standard par |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 52 | 2 | 20% | 52 divided by 13 is 4; divided by 2 is 2 | 2 divided by 0.20 is 10 | 10 |
| 40 | 1 | 25% | 40 divided by 13 is 3.0769 | divided by 0.25 is 12.3077 | 13 |

Both items' units count: hypothetically, 30 units of the substitute and 22 of the retired item in the window give 52 selection units. The inputs are invented.
